Professional Summary 
Software Engineer with 2.5+ years of experience designing and developing scalable 
distributed backend systems using Node.js, NestJS, ReactJS, TypeScript, MongoDB, 
PostgreSQL, and Redis. Experienced in building multi-tenant microservices, REST APIs, API 
Gateways, WebSocket-based real-time systems, and event-driven architectures. Hands-on 
expertise in Keycloak, JWT, RBAC, RabbitMQ, BullMQ, Docker, CI/CD, caching, distributed 
locking, retries, throttling, circuit breakers, and system design. Built enterprise solutions 
including an AI-powered interview platform and a real-time IoT asset tracking platform.

 Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Java 
 Core JavaScript: Async/Await, Promises, Closures, Event Loop, Execution Context, ES6+ 
 Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Express.js 
 Frontend: React.js, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+) 
 Architecture: Microservices, Distributed Systems, REST APIs, API Gateway, WebSockets, 
System Design

 Security: Keycloak, JWT, RBAC 
 DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes (Basics), AWS (EKS, S3 basics), Git, CI/CD

Backend Engineer | Dot AI | Apr 2024 – July 2026

 Developed WebSocket-based real-time communication services.
